name: Laura Shackelford
bio: Professor and Associate Head of Anthropology; Professor of Biomedical and Translational Sciences and Director of Anatomy, Carle Illinois College of Medicine; affiliate in Informatics and in Game Studies & Design. National Geographic Explorer. Her research addresses Late Pleistocene human evolution in Southeast Asia and virtual reality in education. She co-directs fieldwork in northern Laos and studies how VR can widen access to archaeological learning and fieldwork. PhD, Washington University in St. Louis.
